notes: Primary real consumption level; support and precision thresholds are diagnostic eligibility flags and never delete estimates.
Mean log real MPCE robustness outcome; sample-support thresholds apply but no relative-SE cutoff is imposed because relative SE of a log-level mean is not a consumption CV.
Design-based person-weighted median real MPCE; survey quantile uncertainty is retained and support/precision flags never delete estimates.
Design-based mean real MPCE among the bottom 40 percent of represented persons; lower-tail total and variance use convey linearization.
Design-based mean real MPCE among the bottom 20 percent of represented persons; stricter support thresholds reflect the thinner lower-tail domain.
Design-based Gini coefficient of real MPCE using convey::svygini(); retained as a distributional robustness outcome.
Design-based Atkinson index of real MPCE with epsilon=0.5 using convey::svyatk().
Design-based Atkinson index of real MPCE with epsilon=1 using convey::svyatk().
Design-based Atkinson index of real MPCE with epsilon=2 using convey::svyatk(); stricter support reflects greater lower-tail sensitivity.
Design-based Tendulkar poverty headcount ratio, FGT(0), using the canonical real-MPCE threshold implied by the 2011-12 price normalization.
Design-based normalized Tendulkar poverty gap, FGT(1), using the canonical real-MPCE threshold implied by the 2011-12 price normalization.
Design-based squared normalized Tendulkar poverty gap, FGT(2); stricter support reflects greater sensitivity to the poorest represented persons.
